WatchHomePromo.title: Mesej i no senis. Rot bilong ol man lukluk i senis.
WatchHomePromo.description: Mipela i wok gen long video library na ol tool bilong mipela long stat, na putim wok bilong planti yia translation i go long ol platfom we ol man i stap pinis, lukluk, na serim.

WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project em wanpela globol team bilong ol translator, media specialist, editor, na creator i tanim planti yia bilong ministry experience i go long ol tool bilong helpim olgeta disciple-maker.

WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, na analytics i kamap bilong helpim ol ministry long kisim planti man moa long gutpela wei.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Helpim long wokim <highlight>nupela generesen</highlight> bilong tool bilong misin
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Mipela i singautim ol praktisen, creator, na partner long early access. Traim ol nupela tool pastaim, givim feedback, na helpim long wokim ol prodakt bilong tru wok bilong misin.
